records.name: Wartenummerin Baldwohl
records.biography_en: Has been told she is next often enough to wonder what next is measured in. Her HyperNorm queue ticket promises an orderly future without describing its length. A dissonant card asks whether waiting can be acknowledged before the number changes. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Nächste wird nach Maßgabe weiterer Verzögerung angekündigt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has been told she is next often enough to wonder what next is measured in.

records.name: Elixierwart Hilftsicher
records.biography_en: Has a remedy for every doubt except the one printed nowhere on the bottle. His HyperNorm bottle supplies confidence before anyone can examine the contents. A dissonant card asks which question the sales pitch keeps treating as a symptom. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Mittel deckt auch die Zweifel an seinem Bedarf ab.

variant_notes.note_en: Has a remedy for every doubt except the one printed nowhere on the bottle.

records.name: Doktor Altbewährt
records.biography_en: Respects tradition particularly when tradition is unable to answer back. His sealed HyperNorm jar preserves an old practice as proof of its own necessity. A dissonant card asks whether careful observation can include noticing what no longer helps. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bewährung wird durch ihr langes Vorhandensein gestützt.

variant_notes.note_en: Respects tradition particularly when tradition is unable to answer back.

records.name: Magazinwart Immerdieses
records.biography_en: Knows exactly which outdated page will get him through another uncertain hour. His HyperNorm magazines turn yesterday's certainty into a manageable waiting ritual. A dissonant card offers a conversation that has not already been read. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die veraltete Seite bietet weiterhin eine aktuelle Beschäftigung.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows exactly which outdated page will get him through another uncertain hour.

records.name: Quackwart Schnabelrecht
records.biography_en: Can sound professionally reassuring in a register unavailable to the evidence. His HyperNorm horn makes every doubtful claim sound professionally projected. A dissonant card asks whether a louder certificate contains more evidence. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beruhigung erfolgt in fachlich überzeugender Tonlage.

variant_notes.note_en: Can sound professionally reassuring in a register unavailable to the evidence.

records.name: Empfangsdame Erstformular
records.biography_en: Would like to help as soon as the reason for needing help is correctly filed. Her HyperNorm ledger cannot locate the right appointment until the distress is correctly described. A dissonant card asks whether somebody could be welcomed while the form catches up. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Hilfebedarf wartet auf seine ordnungsgemäße Anmeldung.

variant_notes.note_en: Would like to help as soon as the reason for needing help is correctly filed.
